question: What rejuvenating effect results from six months of devoted practice?
premises: The practice is performed for six months with repeated devotion.
Even an old person undergoes transformation.
inference: Therefore, through six months of devoted practice, even an old person becomes youthful.
uncertainties: taruṇā āyate may be read as taruṇāyate (becomes youthful)
plain_english: Through six months of devoted and repeated practice, even an old person becomes youthful.
